title: Shamrock Appears in One Piece Episode 1167 Preview Trailer

title: Kickstarter to Launch for Princess Ai Manga's 20th Anniversary Collection
content: 247 Comics is launching a Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign for a 20th Anniversary Collection of Misaho Kujiradou 's Princess Ai manga. The new edition will include the manga's original trilogy, "rare vault material," and extras. 247 Comics has not yet announced a launch date for the campaign.
author: ANN
